note: The level list a learner works at, as bands over the one difficulty scale (800-3500, step 100). This file is the default an installation starts from; an administrator replaces the stored values at `content.levels` and `content.levels.default`. A task's level is derived from its difficulty and never stored on the task. The bands must be contiguous, non-overlapping and cover the whole scale, which the content gate checks. The names are the stage columns of the POSN syllabus (seed/vocab/raw/posn.json), so they are sourced rather than invented.
